ui.purpose: Everything the developer does: labels, comments, controls. System sans in place of Anthropic Sans.

agent.purpose: Everything the agent says, as claude.ai sets Claude's replies. System serif in place of Anthropic Serif.

label.purpose: Meta lines: element under a comment, batch time, status words.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Comment card and pin thread, measured from Claude Design's comment card.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Tool pill, Ask bar and the hover tag, floating over the host page.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Focused card or field. The one coloured shadow, copied from the reference, focus only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Cards rise 4px in 140ms, pins pop from 60% in 200ms, the highlight follows the pointer in 80ms.

motion.name: listening
motion.purpose: The header dot while the agent is listening. Off with reduced motion.

motion.name: working
motion.purpose: 'Working on it' while the agent has the batch. Off with reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: panel
breakpoints.purpose: Chrome side panel's usual width; the panel is a single column at any width.

components.name: Comment Card
components.description: Opens beside a pin at the clicked point; Enter adds the comment to the stack.
components.html:
h1 · “Simple pricing”

@Claude Make the headline bolder
components.css: .ds-comment { width: 300px; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: #1f1f1f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04), 0 1px 2px rgb(10 10 10 / 0.06), 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.24); color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.93); font: 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-comment:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #257de0, 0 0 6px 1px rgb(23 87 172 / 0.6); } .ds-comment-target { margin: 0 0 8px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.52); font-size: 12px; } .ds-comment-body { margin: 0; } .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-box { width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 5px; background: #303030; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); }

components.name: Agent Chip
components.description: Names the connected agent on the comment's first line.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 11px; background: rgb(37 125 224 / 0.12); color: #6aabf1; font: 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Comment Pin
components.description: Sharp bottom-left corner on the clicked point; the disc carries the number or the status glyph.
components.css: .ds-pin { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 16px 16px 16px 0; background: #257de0; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); transform-origin: 0 100%; } .ds-pin:hover { transform: scale(1.08); } .ds-pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-disc { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; background: #454545; color: #fff; font: 600 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Selection
components.description: Selected element while commenting: 2px blue line, square corners, 6% blue fill. No handles: nothing resizes. Hover is the same line with rounded corners and no fill.
components.css: .ds-selection { width: 220px; height: 48px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 2px solid #257de0; background: rgb(37 125 224 / 0.06); }

components.name: Tool Pill
components.description: Bottom centre while picking: comment tool, count, Ask <agent>, Done.
components.html: 2 comments
components.css: .ds-tools { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: #1f1f1f; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), 0 4px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); font: 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool { height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.62); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { background: #303030; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.93); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #257de0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-active, .ds-ask { background: rgb(37 125 224 / 0.12); color: #6aabf1; } .ds-ask:hover { background: rgb(37 125 224 / 0.2); color: #6aabf1; } .ds-count { padding: 0 8px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.52); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: Bottom of the side panel: stacked comments ride above the message field; send at the corner.
components.html: <form class="ds-composer"><textarea class="ds-message" rows="1" placeholder="Describe a change"></textarea><button class="ds-send" aria-label="Send">↑</button></form>
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; width: 320px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 14px; background: #303030; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08), 0 4px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075); } .ds-composer:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #257de0, 0 0 6px 1px rgb(23 87 172 / 0.6); } .ds-message { flex: 1; padding: 4px 6px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.93); caret-color: #257de0; font: 15px/21px system-ui, sans-serif; resize: none; } .ds-message::placeholder { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.52); } .ds-send { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #257de0; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #257de0; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Your Bubble
components.description: A sent batch in the panel thread, right-aligned like your messages in Claude's chat.
components.html:
1 h1 · /pricing

Make the headline bolder
components.css: .ds-bubble { max-width: 300px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.93); font: 14px/21px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ref { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 2px; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.52); font-size: 12px; } .ds-num { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 9px 9px 9px 0; background: #1f6fcb; color: #fff; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-text { margin: 0; }

components.name: Agent Reply
components.description: The agent's reply to one comment: its number in a status-coloured badge, the words in the serif.
components.html:
1

Headline is now 40px, weight 800.
components.css: .ds-reply { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 1fr; gap: 10px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-reply .ds-num { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 2px; border-radius: 9px 9px 9px 0; background: #23824a; color: #fff; font: 600 10.5px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-reply-text { margin: 0; color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.93); font: 15px/22px ui-serif, Georgia, serif; }

narrative.northStar: Claude Design's canvas, on your running app
narrative.overview:
The extension copies Claude Design at the user's request: dark chrome, one blue for every selection and comment job, comment pins at the clicked point, a dark comment card, a bottom tool pill and an Ask bar, and claude.ai's chat for the side panel. Values were measured from claude.ai on 2026-11-19. It is dark only.

The look is Claude Design's; the words follow whichever coding agent is connected. Labels take the agent's name from its session (Claude, OpenCode) and fall back to "Agent".
keyCharacteristics: One blue, #257de0, for selection, pins, send and focus
Pins with a sharp corner on the clicked point
System sans for the developer, a serif for the agent

rules.name: Status in the disc
rules.body: The pin stays blue; its disc shows the number, or turns green with a check (done) or amber with a question mark (question). Every status has its own glyph.

rules.name: Selection without handles
rules.body: Hover is a 2px line; selection is the same line, square, with a faint blue fill. The canvas's resize handles are left out because nothing here resizes.

rules.name: Agent-neutral words
rules.body: Never write Claude into UI copy; name the session's agent. 'In Claude Code, run …' is fine where the step is Claude Code's.

dos: Do keep overlay styles in the constructed sheet: page CSPs block <style> tags.
Do put page text in with textContent only.
Do keep small white digits on the darker badge fills (#1f6fcb, #23824a).
donts: Don't add a light theme without measuring Claude's.
Don't show controls that do nothing (mic, formatting toolbar).
Don't make 'Send to <agent>' the default: stack, then send.
